elections.title: VOI Council Election
elections.description: Elect 5 members to the VOI Council for 2024-2025 term

candidates.name: atlas.voi
candidates.bio: Long-time VOI contributor and validator. Focused on network security and scalability.
candidates.campaignStatement: I'm committed to advancing VOI's technical infrastructure and ensuring network security remains our top priority.

candidates.name: cosmos.voi
candidates.bio: Cross-chain specialist with expertise in interoperability protocols.
candidates.campaignStatement: My focus will be on expanding VOI's cross-chain capabilities and building bridges to other ecosystems.

candidates.name: founder.voi
candidates.bio: Core protocol developer and governance advocate.
candidates.campaignStatement: I bring deep protocol knowledge and a vision for decentralized governance that empowers the community.

candidates.name: dao.voi
candidates.bio: Decentralized governance expert and community builder.
candidates.campaignStatement: I will work to improve governance processes and ensure all community voices are heard in decision-making.

candidates.name: tech.voi
candidates.bio: Technical architect specializing in blockchain infrastructure.
candidates.campaignStatement: I will focus on technical excellence and innovation to keep VOI at the forefront of blockchain technology.

candidates.name: community.voi
candidates.bio: Community advocate and user experience specialist.
candidates.campaignStatement: I will ensure the community's needs are prioritized in all Foundation decisions.

candidates.name: finance.voi
candidates.bio: Financial strategist with DeFi and treasury management expertise.
candidates.campaignStatement: I will focus on sustainable financial growth and responsible treasury management.

candidates.name: research.voi
candidates.bio: Blockchain researcher and academic with focus on consensus mechanisms.
candidates.campaignStatement: I will drive research initiatives and academic partnerships to advance VOI's technology.
